review.reason: The change implements a fan-out fetching mechanism for GitGuardian warehouse ingestion, allowing hierarchical traversal of parent-child relationships (e.g., workspace -> team) by substituting parent IDs into child paths. review.uncertainty: The tier assignment relies on the implementation of warehouse ingestion capabilities rather than observed adoption or incident avoidance. The benefit is demonstrated by the code's ability to support hierarchical data retrieval and expanded endpoint support, but actual usage and its impact on warehouse reliability or customer benefit are not established by this patch.
